scenes.title: The A shape
scenes.subtitle: Bm, Bb and friends.
lines: Welcome.
This lesson teaches the A shape: Bm, Bb and friends.
Practice them slowly, and you'll build strength and confidence with barre chords.

scenes.heading: The A shape
lines: Place finger 1 across strings 5 to 1, then form an A or Am shape two frets higher.
The barre at fret 2 gives you Bm, at fret 1 gives Bb major, and at fret 3 gives C major.
Skip string 6 — the note on string 5 under the barre tells you the chord's name.
You've got this — one barre opens the whole neck.
Play it slow, and let the sound guide you.
Let's learn the B minor barre chord.
Press finger 1 flat across fret 2, from string 5 to string 1.
Lay finger 1 flat across fret 2, from string 5 to string 1.
Finger 2 goes on string 2, fret 3.
Finger 3 goes on string 4, fret 4.
Finger 4 goes on string 3, fret 4.
Don't play string 6.
Here's how it sounds: strummed, then string by string.
scenes.tip: Barre strings 5 to 1 at fret 2 and skip string 6. If the full barre is hard, start by fretting only strings 4 to 1.

lines: Let's learn B flat major.
Press finger 1 flat across fret 1, from string 5 to 1.
Lay finger 1 flat across fret 1, from string 5 to string 1.
Finger 2 goes on string 4, fret 3.
Finger 3 goes on string 3, fret 3.
Finger 4 goes on string 2, fret 3.
Don't play string 6.
Here's how it sounds: strummed, then string by string.
scenes.tip: Barre fret 1 across strings 5 to 1, with fingers 2, 3 and 4 lined up on fret 3. Keep string 1 ringing under the barre.

lines: Let's shape the C major chord with a barre at fret 3, keeping the pressure on string 1.
Lay finger 1 flat across fret 3, from string 5 to string 1.
Finger 2 goes on string 4, fret 5.
Finger 3 goes on string 3, fret 5.
Finger 4 goes on string 2, fret 5.
Don't play string 6.
Here's how it sounds: strummed, then string by string.
scenes.tip: The A shape at fret 3: the same chord as open C with a tighter sound. Keep the barre pressing string 1.

lines: Let's practice changing between D major, B minor, G major and A major.
Move smoothly from one to the next, focusing on clear finger placement and even timing.
Let's put it all together.
Play Bm, Bb or C — the app will listen through the microphone and help you sound your best.
